verification.note: Fresh public primary transcription retrieved200; exact saved paragraph witnessP3–26andP198–214checked; final bounded opening checkP15–26retains ancient-source, joint legal-history and anthropological-resource roles as her attributed claims. P6criticizes class-struggle totalization attributed to Marx;P7qualifies that quoted thinkers did not confine all their thought to such formulas. The CommunistManifestois joint Marx/Engels work, despite Beard’s singular attribution; neither original read here. P12–13credits Condorcet/Guizot civilizational scheme, whileP207–209Bury/Picard and jointly authored BeardsAmericanSpirit retain distinct roles. P211–214civilization claims remain her arguments, not proof of women’s universal moral superiority. Whole chapter/book and original print not collated; all12chapter bodies saved raw for locator checking, not all read.
